generations.prompt: The woman looks directly into the camera with a calm, warm half-smile. She speaks the line clearly and naturally, with placid, steady, almost too-calm delivery — a hair detached, conversational warmth: "I left him at the altar this morning. I made the right choice." Her gaze remains unblinking and slightly-too-steady throughout the line. Subtle natural micro-expressions — a slight tilt of the head, a barely perceptible lift at the corner of her mouth on the words "right choice." Clear intimate testimonial speaking voice — neither emotional nor flat. Soft natural window light unchanging. Static camera, framed chest-up, no zoom or pan. Quiet living room ambience, no music.
